methods.encycolorpedia: Exact Tamiya enamel retail code match; copy published hex. Ignore nearest-color matches. Unmatched codes use the official Tamiya chart.
methods.tamiyaChart: 2024 manufacturer PDF, page 2, exact code text -> its hexagonal chip. ICC-enabled MuPDF 1.28.2 rendered the listed 6x6 pt center crop at 4x into sRGB; per-channel median.
methods.mrHobbyChart: 2024–2025 manufacturer PDF. Match the main number within each C/H/N series cell, never cross-reference numbers. ICC-enabled MuPDF 1.28.2 rendered the listed 6x6 pt chip crop at 4x into sRGB; per-channel median.
methods.goldenSoFlatSwatch: Exact 6xxx SoFlat product, not another Golden series. Official 1000x1000 webp brush-out; convert embedded sRGB IEC61966-2.1 with relative-colorimetric intent, per-channel median of [360,470,410,510], the painted white-backed gap between the first two black opacity-test stripes. White margins, black stripes and edges are excluded. This is image sampling, not manufacturer-measured RGB.

limitations: Digital screen references only; physical paint, film thickness, lighting, finish and mixing may differ. PDF colors are print-chart conversions using MuPDF color management; no physical accuracy or Delta E is asserted.
